title: Old Age Security Scheme
summary: SSF's core retirement pension scheme. Contributors accumulate funds in an individual account throughout their career (employee 11% + employer 20% of basic salary). Monthly pension begins at age 60. If contribution period is insufficient, lump sum withdrawal is available.
nepaliSummary: SSF को मुख्य अवकाश पेन्सन योजना। योगदानकर्ताहरूले सम्पूर्ण करियरमा व्यक्तिगत खातामा रकम जम्मा गर्छन् (कर्मचारी ११% + नियोक्ता २०% आधार तलबको)। ६० वर्षको उमेरमा मासिक पेन्सन सुरु हुन्छ। योगदान अवधि पर्याप्त नभए एकमुष्ट निकाल्न पाइन्छ।
benefits: Monthly pension for life from age 60
Individual account — your money stays yours
Employer contributes 20% on top of your 11%
Lump sum available if minimum period not met
eligibility: All formal sector employees whose employer is registered with SSF
Informal and self-employed workers (voluntary registration)
Foreign employment workers (special provision)
Minimum contribution: 15 years to qualify for monthly pension
Pension age: 60 years

title: Dependent Family Security Scheme
summary: Provides financial support to the immediate family of a deceased SSF contributor. On natural death, family receives a lump sum equivalent to 7 months' basic salary. On accidental death, benefits are higher. After the contributor's death, dependents also receive ongoing monthly support.
nepaliSummary: मृत्यु भएको SSF योगदानकर्ताको परिवारलाई आर्थिक सहायता दिन्छ। स्वाभाविक मृत्युमा परिवारले ७ महिनाको आधार तलब बराबर एकमुष्ट रकम पाउँछ। दुर्घटनाजन्य मृत्युमा थप सुविधा। योगदानकर्ताको मृत्युपछि आश्रितहरूले मासिक सहायता पनि पाउँछन्।
benefits: Lump sum on natural death (7 months salary)
eligibility: Active SSF contributor at time of death
Minimum contribution period must be met
Claimant must be legal heir, spouse, or dependent child
Claim must be filed within prescribed period after death
Death certificate and relationship proof required
documents: Relationship proof (marriage certificate or birth certificate)

title: Accident and Disability Protection Scheme
summary: Provides compensation to SSF contributors who suffer accidents or disabilities — whether at the workplace or outside. Full (100%) disability entitles the contributor to a lifetime monthly pension. Partial disability receives a percentage. Accidental death triggers the Dependent Family scheme at enhanced rates.
nepaliSummary: कार्यस्थल वा बाहिर दुर्घटना वा अपाङ्गतामा परेका SSF योगदानकर्ताहरूलाई क्षतिपूर्ति दिन्छ। पूर्ण (१००%) अपाङ्गतामा जीवनभर मासिक पेन्सन पाइन्छ। आंशिक अपाङ्गतामा प्रतिशतका आधारमा। दुर्घटनाजन्य मृत्युमा आश्रित परिवार योजना बढी दरमा सक्रिय हुन्छ।
benefits: Lifetime monthly pension for full disability
eligibility: Active SSF contributor at time of accident
Accident must be reported to SSF within 7 days
Medical assessment of disability degree required
Employer accident report for workplace accidents
Minimum 3 months of SSF contributions
Disability certificate from authorized medical board
documents: Accident report (police report or employer report)

title: Maternity Security Benefit
summary: SSF maternity benefit provides paid maternity leave equivalent to 60 days of basic salary for female contributors, plus a childcare grant for the first year of the child's life. Applicable for the first two children. Male contributors are also entitled to paternity leave support.
nepaliSummary: SSF मातृत्व सुविधाले महिला योगदानकर्ताहरूलाई ६० दिनको आधार तलब बराबर सवेतन मातृत्व बिदा र शिशुको पहिलो वर्षको बाल स्याहार अनुदान दिन्छ। पहिलो दुई सन्तानका लागि लागू। पुरुष योगदानकर्ताले पनि पितृत्व बिदा सहायता पाउँछन्।
eligibility: Active female SSF contributor
Minimum 6 months of SSF contributions before delivery
Applicable for first two children only
Must be employed at time of birth
Claim must be filed within 60 days of birth
Male contributors: minimum 3 months contribution for paternity

title: Medical Treatment and Health Facility
summary: SSF healthcare scheme reimburses outpatient (OPD) and inpatient (IPD) medical expenses for contributors and their immediate family. OPD covers up to NPR 10,000/year per family. IPD hospitalization covers up to NPR 1,00,000/year. Treatment must be at SSF-empanelled hospitals.
nepaliSummary: SSF स्वास्थ्य योजनाले योगदानकर्ता र उनीहरूको नजिकको परिवारको बाह्य रोगी (OPD) र आन्तरिक रोगी (IPD) चिकित्सा खर्च प्रतिपूर्ति गर्छ। OPD मा परिवारको लागि प्रतिवर्ष १०,००० सम्म। IPD अस्पताल भर्नामा प्रतिवर्ष १,००,००० सम्म। उपचार SSF सूचीकृत अस्पतालहरूमा हुनुपर्छ।
eligibility: Active SSF contributor
Treatment at SSF-empanelled hospitals only
Family: spouse and dependent children under 18
Claim must be filed within 35 days of treatment
Original hospital bills and prescriptions required
Annual limit resets each fiscal year

title: Home Loan
summary: SSF contributors can borrow from their accumulated individual fund for house purchase or construction. Loan is secured against the contributor's own accumulated SSF balance. Interest rate is lower than commercial banks. Repayment is made via monthly salary deductions.
nepaliSummary: SSF योगदानकर्ताहरूले घर खरिद वा निर्माणको लागि आफ्नो जम्मा व्यक्तिगत कोषबाट सापटी लिन सक्छन्। ऋण आफ्नै जम्मा SSF मौज्दातमा सुरक्षित हुन्छ। व्यावसायिक बैंकभन्दा कम ब्याजदर। मासिक तलब कट्टाबाट तिर्न पाइन्छ।
eligibility: Active SSF contributor for minimum 2 years
Sufficient accumulated fund balance
Property must be within Nepal
Purpose: purchase or construction of residential home
Employer certification required
No existing loan default with SSF
loanLimit: Up to 70% of accumulated individual SSF fund balance

title: Education Loan
summary: SSF education loan lets contributors borrow from their accumulated fund for higher education costs — for themselves or dependent children. Covers tuition fees, living expenses, and study materials at recognized institutions inside or outside Nepal.
nepaliSummary: SSF शैक्षिक सापटीले योगदानकर्ताहरूलाई आफ्नो वा आश्रित सन्तानको उच्च शिक्षाको खर्चका लागि जम्मा कोषबाट उधारो लिन दिन्छ। नेपाल वा विदेशका मान्यताप्राप्त शिक्षण संस्थामा ट्युशन, बसोबास र पढाइ सामग्रीको खर्च समेट्छ।
eligibility: Active SSF contributor for minimum 1 year
Admission letter from recognized institution required
For dependent child: proof of relationship
Sufficient accumulated fund balance
No existing loan default with SSF
Employer certification required
loanLimit: Up to 50% of accumulated individual SSF fund balance

title: Special Loan
summary: SSF special loan allows contributors to borrow from their accumulated fund for any personal need. Quick processing with no external collateral required. Interest rate is lower than commercial banks. The contributor's own accumulated SSF fund acts as security.
nepaliSummary: SSF विशेष सापटीले योगदानकर्ताहरूलाई कुनै पनि व्यक्तिगत आवश्यकताका लागि जम्मा कोषबाट उधारो लिन दिन्छ। बाह्य धितो नचाहिने, छिटो प्रक्रिया। व्यावसायिक बैंकभन्दा कम ब्याजदर। आफ्नै जम्मा SSF कोष सुरक्षाको रूपमा काम गर्छ।
eligibility: Active SSF contributor for minimum 1 year
Sufficient accumulated fund balance
No existing loan default with SSF
Employer certification required
loanLimit: Up to 60% of accumulated individual SSF fund balance

title: Foreign Employment Security
summary: Special SSF provisions for Nepali workers in foreign employment. Migrant workers registered with SSF receive insurance discounts, accident coverage abroad, and can accumulate retirement funds while working overseas. Enables foreign workers to build social security coverage from abroad.
nepaliSummary: विदेशी रोजगारमा रहेका नेपाली श्रमिकहरूका लागि विशेष SSF व्यवस्था। SSF मा दर्ता भएका प्रवासी श्रमिकहरूले बीमा छुट, विदेशमा दुर्घटना सुरक्षा र विदेश काम गर्दा अवकाश कोष जम्मा गर्न पाउँछन्। विदेशी कामदारहरूलाई विदेशबाटै सामाजिक सुरक्षा बनाउन सक्षम बनाउँछ।
benefits: Discounted insurance premium for migrant workers
Build Nepal retirement fund from overseas
Family protection while worker is abroad
eligibility: Nepali citizen working in foreign employment
Must have valid foreign employment permit
Registration with SSF before or during foreign employment
Voluntary enrollment — not mandatory
Can contribute from abroad via designated channels
